Theorem
[Hyperbolic submanifold lower bound] \group relative-invariant ↗ thurston-ch06-relative-gromov-proportionality Source: thurston:page-0150, thurston:page-0151

If a closed oriented $3$-manifold $M$ contains an embedded finite-volume complete hyperbolic submanifold $H$ whose compactification has incompressible boundary, then \[ \| [M]\| \geq \frac{v(H)}{v_3}. \]
